margin_level_answer_third:
1. Top Up Margin: This is the most direct method to quickly increase your margin level.
2. Proactively Reduce Positions: Close some losing positions first to release margin.
3. Set Stop Loss: Set a stop loss for each position to control single-trade losses at the source.
4. Stay Vigilant: During periods of high market volatility, closely monitor your margin level.
